title: The Rook That Never Stops
setup: Black's king is still on e8, with a rook on g5 and a bishop on h8, and your rook already sits on f6.
hint: Two rooks split the job: one herds the king with checks, and the other waits for it on a far file.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rf8+}} and {{Rf7+}} walk the king out into the open, and {{Rxa6#}} mates along the sixth with the queen on f5 sealing the fifth rank. One rook walks the king out and the other is already waiting on the a-file.
